# Monolith Log

## 2026-05-04

This entry is one unbroken paragraph with no child headings, no thematic break and no blank line inside it, which is the case where no break point exists at all; the engine must return it whole and mark it oversize rather than cutting it at an arbitrary offset, because a half entry reads exactly like a whole one to the caller and there is no way to tell from the text that anything was removed; the ceiling is a budgeting device and a declared unit is a contract, so the contract wins; everything after this clause exists only to push the word count past a low test ceiling and to prove that the whole unit still comes back from read; the tank was full, the manifold held, the valves were quiet, the emitters ran clean, the filter was rinsed, the zone map was correct, and nothing at all went wrong on this particular day.
